title: Austria - 2026.08.07
notes: Austria remains politically rudderless as rival parties clash over deficit reduction, far-right representation, and the pace of economic recovery. With the budget deficit projected to exceed four percent of GDP and two consecutive years of economic contraction behind it, the country faces a rare combination of political and economic fragility. The outcome of coalition talks will determine the severity of spending cuts and the prospects for millions of households already worn down by prolonged economic weakness.
